lines.en: I follow you, keeping three steps.
You turn, and I withdraw.
I walk at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 我的脚步正好压在你的后面
lines.en: My steps land right after yours.

lines.zh: 我绕过柱子，不让你看见
lines.en: I round the pillar out of your view.
The corridor lamps dim one by one.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，影子贴着你
lines.en: I move along the wall, my shadow on yours.

lines.zh: 我离得很近，但你又抓不到
lines.en: I'm near, yet you can't catch me.

lines.zh: 我停的时候，你也感觉到了
lines.en: When I stop, you feel it.
I fall back two steps and follow again.

lines.zh: 我从这面墙换到那面墙
lines.en: I shift from this wall to that one.

lines.zh: 我总在你刚好看不见的地方
lines.en: I'm always just where you can't see.
I stand in the doorway, watching you.
I don't move, and I don't leave.
I'm learning your habits.
When will you look back?
When will you sit down?
I've noted all of it.

lines.zh: 我保持着刚好不够近的距离。
lines.en: I keep just out of reach.

lines.zh: 你背对我的时候，我就在那
lines.en: When your back is turned, I'm there.
This room is very quiet.
Quiet enough for you to hear me.
But I never make a sound.
I'm merely watching.
Your breathing sped up a little.

lines.zh: 我知道你在想我还在不在
lines.en: I know you're wondering if I'm still here.
I've been watching you all along.

lines.zh: 你一抬头，我就退到阴影里
lines.en: You look up, and I step into shadow.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，但知道我在
lines.en: You can't see me, but you know I'm here.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一个房间的距离
lines.en: We're one room apart.

lines.zh: 你转过来的时候，那里没有人
lines.en: When you turn, no one's there.
Then I'm back in the doorway.
You feel it on your neck, don't you?
That feeling is me.

lines.zh: 我不靠近，是因为还没到时候
lines.en: I keep my distance. It isn't time yet.
When it is, I won't withdraw.
That's a good spot you're standing in.
Wall behind you. Me in front.
Run. I won't chase—I'll follow.
I'll follow, not chase.
Chasing spoils it.
I like it when you walk back to me.
See? You looked back again.
That's what I like.
Look back at me once more.
I'm always right there.
You hit me and I step back.
I retreat past the door, still watching.
There's no blood in the wound.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有从你身上移开
lines.en: My eyes don't leave you.
It hurts, and I keep watching.
Want me closer?
Then we can drop the distance.
I tilt my head a little.
You struck first.

lines.zh: 我的伤在你眼里是黑的。
lines.en: In your eyes my wound is black.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我就靠近一点
lines.en: You hold it up and I come a little closer.

lines.zh: 不是因为它，是因为你分神了
lines.en: Not because of it, but because you're distracted.

lines.zh: 你放下手的时候，我会更近
lines.en: When you lower your hand, I'll be nearer.

lines.zh: 你这一招对我毫无用处
lines.en: That trick of yours is useless to me.
I never eat. I only watch you.
I want you not looking at the door.

lines.zh: 你注意力在它上面，很好
lines.en: Your attention is on it. Good.
Hold it a while longer.
I watch your hand, not the thing.
Your arm will tire and drop.
You bump me and step back.

lines.zh: 我也退了一步，刚好一样
lines.en: I step back exactly as far.
I've kept that distance.
Your breath reaches me.
Too close. I move back.
You reach out and I'm gone.
I appear at your flank.
You came up empty again.
There's always an arm's length between us.
This is exactly right.
We'll stay within two steps.
You needn't look at me. I'll watch you.
I never leave this room.
And I won't let you either.
I know your footfall.
No one else walks like that.

lines.zh: 我们就这样，一个看一个
lines.en: So we go: one watching, one watched.
That isn't loneliness, is it?

lines.zh: 你睡着的时候，我就在门口
lines.en: When you sleep, I'm at the door.
I'm awake the whole night.

lines.zh: 你的东西，我先替你拿着。
lines.en: I'll hold on to what you dropped.
I'll keep it until you come for it.
Then you'll turn around.

lines.zh: 我把它放在你看得见的地方
lines.en: I set it where you can see it.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的时候，我靠近了一点
lines.en: When you bent down, I came a little closer.
Now I've withdrawn again.
The thing is sitting right here.
Come over and take it from me.
I'll stand still.
And wait for you to come.
You've stopped moving. Then we begin.
This time I won't withdraw.
I've seen enough of you.
Turn around and I'm there.
Only one step of distance left.

lines.zh: 你走得再快，我都在后头。
lines.en: However fast you walk, I'm behind you.
I'll wait for you to find it.
That's a little fairer.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，但不会靠近。
lines.en: I watch you, but I won't come close.
Then I'm coming over.
No running. No shouting.
Just one step at a time.
Can you hear this sound?

lines.zh: 我的脚步已经不在原地了
lines.en: My steps aren't where they were.
I'm right behind you.
Now is the time.
I move to your rear flank.
You turn; I circle with you.
We stay one arm apart.
You retreat; I retreat to keep the gap.
Until you back into the corner.
Then the distance is gone.
Your breathing has gone shallow.
I'm counting how many steps you take.
Seventeen steps. Eighteen.
Your legs are tiring.
I'm still standing, quite still.
The lamp flickers. Don't blink.

lines.zh: 眨眼的那一瞬，我会更近
lines.en: In that blink I'll be closer.
See? I'm closer again.
Blink one more time.
The wall is right behind you.
I've already raised my hand.
You've finally stopped retreating.
Then I won't either.
This is just right now.
My hand settles on your nape.
You turn and meet me.
This is light, like a greeting.
I bring my face close to yours.
I say nothing at all.
You go rigid all over.
My hand slides down from your shoulder.
Don't move. Just like this.
I've been waiting for this distance.
You can't back away now.
Your back is against the wall.
And the way ahead is me.
This grip isn't heavy at all.
But I won't let go.
Listen. The room has gone quiet.
The room is so quiet.

lines.zh: 我一直在，只是你现在才看见
lines.en: I was always here. You only just saw me.

lines.zh: 门口的阴影里多了一道
lines.en: A new shape in the doorway's shadow.
You feel the cold first, then see me.
I stand without a sound.

lines.zh: 这间屋子有第二个呼吸
lines.en: This room has a second breath.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我还没有
lines.en: I wasn't there when you last looked.
Now there is one here.
I won't approach. I'll watch first.
To see how long you take to notice.
You're quicker than the last one.
The light tube ticks.
That was me touching the switch.
There's a place at the corridor's end.
I'm standing right there.
You may walk over.
Or wait for me to come.
I don't mind waiting.

lines.zh: 睁眼之前，我已经在这里。
lines.en: Before you opened your eyes, I was here.
The door has shut.
Now it's only us.
Firelight reveals me. I dislike it.
I fall, my eyes still turned up.
Water covers me and I'm still watching.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推远，我走回来
lines.en: The blast pushes me off; I walk back.
The arrow passes through and sticks in the frame.
That light forces my eyes shut.
The longer I wait, the hungrier I get.
The flash shows where I am.
No wall left to lean on and watch.
